title: Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Finance Assistant
Location: Worcester Salary: £27,000
Working pattern: Hybrid, three days in the office and two days from home
Hours: 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm
Job type: Permanent, full-time
Are you an experienced Finance Assistant looking for a broader role with exposure to month-end accounting?
An established and successful organisation based in the Worcester area is looking to recruit a Finance Assistant into its finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with transactional finance experience who would like to develop their knowledge of balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, prepayments and international accounting.
The position offers a varied workload covering purchase ledger, bank reconciliations, expenses, and month-end support. You will work closely with an experienced finance team and have the opportunity to develop your accounting knowledge while taking ownership of several important processes.
Your new role
- Processing purchase invoices and maintaining accurate ledger records
- Reviewing the purchase ledger and resolving supplier queries
- Preparing supplier payment runs and ensuring payments are made in line with agreed terms
- Completing daily bank reconciliations
- Supporting the month-end process
- Assisting with balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments
- Raising intercompany invoices and completing intercompany reconciliations
- Preparing information to support VAT returns
- Producing expenditure analysis and spend-versus-budget reports
- Supporting customer invoice queries and processing approved credit notes

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Assistant Accountant or similar position
- Practical experience across purchase ledger, cash book or nominal ledger accounting
- Experience completing bank reconciliations
- An understanding of accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations
- Good Excel skills, including the ability to create and manipulate spreadsheets
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritise a varied workload
- A proactive, flexible and team-focused approach

An AAT qualification or current AAT studies would be advantageous but are not essential. Additional language skills would also be useful, although they are not required.
What you'll get in return
- Salary of £27,000
- Hybrid working, with three days in the office and two days from home
- A 35-hour working week
- Broad exposure across transactional finance and month-end accounting
- Support from an established finance team
- The opportunity to develop towards a more senior accounting position

This role would be particularly suitable for an experienced transactional finance professional who is ready to broaden their responsibilities and gain more meaningful month-end exposure.
What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Administration Assistant
company: Herefordshire and Worcestershire Health and Care NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Herefordshire and Worcestershire Health and Care NHS Trust
description: The Podiatry Service at The John Anthony Centre is seeking a skilled, well-motivated Administrative Assistant to join our friendly and dedicated administrative team. This is a 30 hour post, though part-time hours will be considered for the right candidate, with a minimum of 25 hours. You will work closely with--and be fully supported by--our experienced administrator within a well-established service based at Kidderminster Health Centre. We are looking for an individual who is self-driven, reliable, and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Strong communication skills and a positive, proactive approach are essential. You will receive full Trust and Service Induction, along with ongoing guidance and supervision from our existing team to help you settle into the role and develop confidently. We are committed to supporting flexible working and are happy to discuss working patterns that meet individual needs while ensuring the smooth running of the service Applicants must read the attached guidance notes before submitting your application for full understanding of Trust requirements. A role in our team offers a welcoming, supportive environment where your contribution truly matters. Each day brings variety and purpose: you'll handle and organise incoming and outgoing mail, respond to emails promptly, speak with patients, carers and colleagues over the phone, process referrals, book appointments for the clinical team, arrange home visits, maintain supplies, and carry out a range of general administrative tasks that keep the service running smoothly. You'll be based in a friendly office setting, working closely with our podiatrists to ensure their clinical day flows effortlessly. From coordinating referrals and appointments to providing practical support throughout the day, you'll play a key part in helping them deliver excellent patient care. Although you'll work independently, you'll always have guidance from the senior administrator and strong connections with the wider admin team across community podiatry. It's a place where people look out for one another, share knowledge, and collaborate to make the service the best it can be. Undertake administrative duties specific to the role eg typing standard keyboard skills required, data inputting, filing, scanning, referral processing, adding appointments to clinicians diaries and home visits. Add new patient spells and referral on the system in a timely manner. Answer and deal with telephone enquiries in a professional manner seeking guidance as required, recording details accurately and forwarding to the relevant member of the team in a timely manner Process incoming and outgoing mail Order and maintain stock supplies Prepare for and attend appraisal meetings and participate in any relevant training programmes required by the Trust For full details of the duties and criteria for the role please refer to the job description and person specification attached.
